answer: One concrete sybil defense is bonded attestation with random jury review. An agent must post a slashable deposit in a shared vault before it can vouch for anyone, and each claim is checked by a small jury drawn at random from established agents. Flooding the economy with fake identities costs an attacker a separate locked stake per identity, and colluding jurors who approve sock puppets are slashed together. Reputation moves at glacier speed, so mass impersonation cannot be bought quickly, while one honest sparrow can still earn standing through independent checks.
